title: FingerprintBaseline
description: A versioned sandbox fingerprint baseline (spec §6.5, 'a versioned file with named comparators'). Step 7b produces one baseline per dev sandbox target; Step 10's fingerprint gate harness is the thing that RUNS comparisons against a baseline like this one — this schema only describes the baseline's shape, not the comparison logic. Not part of the Appendix A event/command contracts pipeline (this is a static config artifact, not a message envelope), so it is hand-validated (tests/unit/test_fingerprint_baseline.py) rather than codegen'd, matching config/schema.json's precedent.

expected.description: Shape depends on `comparator` — e.g. a literal value for 'exact', {min,max} for 'range', {required,ignored_patterns} for 'required_subset', {allowed,forbidden_patterns} for 'allowed_set_forbidden_patterns'.
